meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. These are counts of accidents recorded by the NTSB, not findings of fault: a probable cause, if any, is in the NTSB's own report. An accident is an event meeting the NTSB's definition, which includes events with no injury. Counts for the latest year are preliminary and are revised as the NTSB closes cases. Claims and deadlines are for your own counsel.

changes.title: Aviation accidents by state updated
changes.summary: The NTSB file now runs through October 28, 2026: in 2026 so far the NTSB recorded 956 U.S. accidents, 134 of them fatal, with 236 deaths.
